messages:
iona_cs: Flag for QBR deck  AcmeCorp account showing a spike in token consumption during onboarding demos. Potential renewal conversation if cost surprise reaches PO. Can finops and enablement triage? :wave:

ben_finops: numbers? 7d vs prior and top routes pls.

iona_cs: short snapshot: 7d embeds+gen = 3.4M (was 480k) -> +608%
est monthly spend increase ~ $22k
main: demo-bot (/api/chat) ~55%, embed-preview ~30%, cron exporter ~15%
no budget alerts configured at account level

budget-bot: Automated: account AcmeCorp usage exceeded typical baseline. Recommend budget alert threshold and temporary quota.

maya_onboard: Likely the demo harness is hitting live model instead of sandbox; also unbatched preview thumbnails. I'll add a quick patch suggestion.

ryan_success: Playbook: 1) apply soft quota to demo-bot route and set 40% alert, 2) outreach with code snippet + recommended sandboxing, 3) include spend delta in QBR and propose one-time mitigation credit. Meeting 30m?

ben_finops: Applied soft quota demo-bot=8rps and alert at 40% consumption. Estimated immediate monthly savings ~ $14k. If they need headroom during demo, propose time-limited promo credit while they switch to sandbox endpoints.

maya_onboard: Draft snippet to send to customer:
```
# prefer sandbox during demos
client = RedwoodClient(env='sandbox')
# batch previews: 200 items / call
```

iona_cs: Actions: ben - keep quota + monitor, maya - send enablement note + snippet, ryan - lead customer sync and QBR slide. I'll update the account health tab with risk=medium.

budget-bot: Quota set: demo-bot=8rps. Alert configured at 40% of monthly allotment. Monitoring enabled.
